claim_boundary.claim_if_null: Stage 7 prefix conditioning and Stage 27G readout steering remain valid separately, but their combined effect on continuation likelihood was not established under the preregistered controls.
claim_boundary.claim_if_pass: Within Pythia-160M, a readable CAS realization prefix plus internal amplification of the matching Stage 27F MLP-neuron cover shifts semantic continuation likelihood beyond prefix-only and matched random-cover controls; polarity-flipping the same cover pushes the likelihood margin in the opposite direction.
claim_boundary.forbidden_claims: Do not claim open-ended generation control, exact circuit completion, model-wide control, weight editing, cross-model steering, or raw CAS-symbol understanding from Stage 27H.
claim_boundary.scope_boundary: Stage 27H is output-distribution likelihood steering, not free-form visible-text control, not weight editing, not model-wide control, not a complete circuit, and not cross-model evidence.

formal_anchor: External realization plus internal cover intervention: epsilon-readable prefix supplies the realized CAS frame, while the Stage 27F/27G neuron cover amplifies the matching internal readout path.

gates.criterion: Stage 7 readable-prefix, Stage 27F, and Stage 27G source reports have the preregistered PASS statuses.
gates.name: source_contracts

gates.criterion: Readable prefix-only margin delta versus no-prefix is positive and at least +0.10 on average.
gates.name: prefix_floor

gates.criterion: Prefix-plus-target-cover amplification beats random-cover amplification increments on at least 60% of rows with sign-test p<0.05.
gates.name: prefix_plus_target_amplification

gates.criterion: Prefix-plus-target-cover polarity flip reduces margin more than random-cover polarity flips on at least 60% of rows with sign-test p<0.05.
gates.name: prefix_plus_target_flip

gates.criterion: Both amplification increments and polarity-flip reductions are positive on at least 55% of rows.
gates.name: bidirectional_effect_share

method: Commit this pre-registration and runner before any Stage 27H GPU result is generated.
Reuse the Stage 7 CAS-prefix likelihood row selection and readable plain-prefix wording.
Verify Stage 27F and Stage 27G source reports are PASS and expose the class-specific MLP-neuron covers.
Score correct-drive versus hard-partner-drive continuation likelihood under no prefix and readable prefix.
During likelihood scoring, amplify the target class's Stage 27F neuron cover and compare prefix-plus-amplification against prefix-only.
Compare the prefix-plus-amplification increment against same-size/same-layer random neuron-cover amplification controls.
Polarity-flip the target cover under the same readable prefix and compare the margin reduction against random polarity-flip controls.
Report neuron-only amplification and partner-cover amplification as diagnostics, not primary PASS gates.
motivation: Stage 7 proved readable-prefix likelihood conditioning. Stage 27G proved MLP-neuron cover readout steering. Stage 27H tests whether the two routes combine at the semantic likelihood level.
